request: Make the GitHub template and skill workflow easier to discover, use make init in the quick start, and update the GitHub listing.
scope: The README, setup and compatibility guides, documentation index and GitHub listing. Both setup entry points use the project assurance interview.
setup: Use a fresh checkout of PARK. Run the quick start in a separate marked template copy with Python, Git and Make.
constraints: Preserve the flag-based setup interface and one-time marker. Keep product-specific discovery limits. Manage GitHub description and topics through the repository settings.

steps.action: Use the existing project assurance interview for make init. Collect and validate all answers before writing project files.

verify.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_template.py -k test_make_init
verify.expected: A marked copy configures once. Interrupted input and an invalid license preserve the template.

steps.action: Lead with the GitHub template workflow, link the local alternative and show how to synchronize a canonical skill into Claude Code.

verify.expected: The repository contract, Markdown links, skill copies and applicable test suites pass.

acceptance.entrypoint: make init in the README quick start
acceptance.given: A fresh marked GitHub template copy.
acceptance.when: Enter a project name, description, languages and workload contexts, accept the suggested assurance level, and choose a license.
acceptance.then: The profile, constitution, README and license reflect the answers. The marker is removed and a second invocation reports completed setup without changing the project.

acceptance.entrypoint: make init with incomplete or invalid answers
acceptance.given: An unconfigured copy containing the original README and license.
acceptance.when: End the input early or submit an unsupported license.
acceptance.then: The command exits unsuccessfully and preserves both files and the marker.
